title: Throwing Good Money After Bad Car Infrastructure - Wonderland Road
summary: Not Just Bikes looks at the cancelled plan to spend over $200 million widening Wonderland Road, a stroad in his hometown of London, Ontario. He asks whether the cancellation marks a turning point away from car-dependent development.
why: Mentioned in threads on stroads and road safety as an example of the channel's critique of wasteful car infrastructure.
